name: Open the Maw
summary: A Deathstalker Agent asks you to clear Dragonmaw from the Excavation Sites and bring back anything of note. The clan may be seeking a path back to power.

sections.title: A Quiet Approach
sections.body: A Deathstalker Agent outside the Excavation Site wants the Dragonmaw forces cleared away. The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan believe they have found something that could restore their former power. Their ragtag presence must be removed so the Deathstalkers can enter unseen. Bring back anything notable you recover, and keep the matter between the agent and royal command.

sections.title: The Recovered Scrawl
sections.body: The Deathstalker Agent recognizes the orcish writing among the recovered items. It shows the Dragonmaw hope to appease Rend, their false warchief. The agent calls the effort fruitless, but the knowledge is valuable to the Dark Lady. The agent leaves the recovered items with you and warns you to say nothing of the mission.

faq.q: Who sent me to the Excavation Site?
faq.answer: A Deathstalker Agent outside the Excavation Site asks you to clear out the Dragonmaw and bring back anything of note.

faq.q: What are the Dragonmaw hoping to do?
faq.answer: The Dragonmaw remnants believe they have found something that could restore their former power.

faq.q: Why do the Deathstalkers want the site cleared?
faq.answer: They want to enter the Excavation Site undetected.
Bring the Deathstalker Agent anything of note you recover from the Dragonmaw.
The agent uses that title for Sylvanas, who leads the Forsaken.

attribution: In-game quest text: Open the Maw
